next_step: Demo with infra + handoff for private vector image POC; provide EU-only deployment checklist
notes: Company: building an in-IDE assistant that surfaces repo-aware context and exact code snippets for completions.
Main goals: reduce context search noise, deterministic retrieval -> allow reproducible completions and traceability back to source file and commit.
Architecture ask: embeddings + vector DB colocated with Redwood Private control plane or run as on-prem container; must support EU data residency and private VPC peering.
Chunking strategy: prefer logical code boundaries (top-level functions, classes, module blocks). Ask for option to index commit-level metadata so assistant can reference exact version.
Vector DB preferences: running Milvus/Weaviate in customer's cluster or Redwood-supplied private image. Need snapshot/restore and export controls.
Performance targets: first-token RTT from IDE extension <= 70ms p50, end-to-end completion for 30-token snippet <= 180ms median; sustain 150 concurrent active editors.
Model/versioning: must pin model per workspace; ability to gate upgrades behind tests. Want quantized 7B for dev workstations and 13B in dedicated infra for heavy tasks.
Streaming: incremental token stream required to render suggestions as-you-type; client uses small-chunk streaming with backpressure handling.
Cost sensitivity: experimenting with batch warmups and cached prefixes; asking Redwood Optimize suggestions for batch sizing and quantization levels.
Security: enterprise SSO, per-repo ACL mapping, audit logs with immutable export, KMS for key management, data retention policies including 'forget' API for removed repos.
POC plan: 60 repos (monorepos included), run end-to-end from IDE plugin to retrieval to model completion. Measure top-3 recall, precision, and token latency. Integrate with internal Git auth.
POC success: top-3 retrieval recall >= 0.80, start-of-stream p50 <70ms, no vectors leaving EU boundaries, reproducible trace linking completion to vector/filename/commit.
Quote (engineering lead): "If we can't point to the exact blob that produced the suggestion, it's a non-starter for legal."
Demo notes (2026-02-24): showed private vector image boot, retrieval latencies 30-90ms in lab; infra asked about cold-start for KV cache and shard sizing.
Legal ask: add clause for data deletion within 30 days of customer request; audit log export in CSV/JSON formats.
Engineering concerns: handling tokenization differences across model families, consistent snippet scoring for reranking, and live repo updates for embeddings.
Routed tasks: SE to provide sizing doc for 150 concurrent devs, step-by-step POC runbook, and sample token & cost estimates for 7B vs 13B.
Commercial: strong expansion potential into enterprise plan if POC shows stable latencies and EU residency satisfied. Procurement aims to finalize contract by May.
